title: Choose ScholarKey's visual world
question: Back to the first hand, as you asked: the Departures Board or Chromatic Interference?

options.label: Departures Board
options.lineage: Solari split-flap departure boards and airport wayfinding signage
options.thesis: Every diploma is a departure: the board flips each check to VERIFIED, row by row, in public.
options.viewport: A full-width split-flap board heads the page: the ScholarKey line flips in, a white boarding-pass slot reads 'Drop a diploma PDF to verify', and a yellow signage panel points institutions to 'Issue credentials'.
options.risk: Split-flap is a known novelty; it turns gimmick if flaps move without real events or the board swallows body text.

raised.raise: One character-cell grid: every flap, label and numeral on the board snaps to it; nothing floats.
States print themselves: status is flap text in its row, never a pill, toast or badge.
Running order is visible: every check and section carries a code (SK 01, GATE 2) like a flight number.
One calm white panel: the boarding-pass drop slot is the only white surface on the board.
Blank at rest: flaps move only for real events, never as ambient decoration.
Measured rows: each check reports real numbers (ms, bytes hashed, block height) in tabular figures.

options.label: Chromatic Interference
options.lineage: Caracas kinetic art: Cruz-Diez physichromies and the Maiquetía airport floor
options.thesis: Truth resolves when you look closely: fine-line colour fields that settle into a verdict, from the art of Caracas.
options.viewport: A white page cut by a band of dense vertical colour lines; the headline in a plain grotesk, the drop zone a gap in the lines that turns solid green when a diploma verifies.
options.risk: Fine-line moiré fights readability and projector scaling, and it leans on a protected artist's language: it must stay a grammar, never a copy.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean trust SaaS page: verify academic credentials instantly.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline over an upload box, three feature cards below, logos strip.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every credential startup by design.
